data_objects.name: genomic_interval_trees
data_objects.meaning: Genomic interval records with interval boundaries, SNP and sample-coverage measures, and a phylogenetic tree encoded as text.

variables.name: Unnamed: 0
variables.meaning: Sequential row label introduced by a prior table index; it has no stated biological meaning.

variables.name: start
variables.meaning: Start coordinate of the genomic interval.

variables.name: end
variables.meaning: End coordinate of the genomic interval.

variables.name: nsnps
variables.meaning: Number of SNPs associated with the interval.

variables.name: nsamplecov
variables.meaning: Numeric sample-coverage measure for the interval; the precise definition is not stated.

variables.name: tree
variables.meaning: Parenthesized phylogenetic tree representation with named tips, branch lengths, and numeric internal annotations.

structure.description: Each row associates one start-to-end genomic interval with SNP, sample-coverage, and tree information.
The tree field uses a Newick-like parenthesized encoding with colon-delimited branch lengths and internal numeric labels.

uncertainties: The coordinate system, interval endpoint convention, reference sequence, branch-length unit, and interpretation of internal tree annotations are not specified.
The exact definition of nsamplecov is not supplied.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels and encodings visible in train.csv.
